responseTime.message: I aim to respond to all messages within 24 hours (except weekends). If you don’t receive a response within 2 days, please feel free to resend your message.
responseTime.urgentNote: Need something urgent? Please specify "URGENT" in the subject and I will do my best to prioritize it.
